title: Fantastic tapas tour !!
text: We went for a tapas tour with First time Barcelona and it was such a fun experience !! The guide was really friendly and fun and well prepared, gave us lots of interesting information about the city as well as the food specialities in town! Also the restaurants and tapas they selected were so delicious 😻 the paella was fasntastic! Totally worth it and recommend it if you want to have a different experience in town
author: sofiamE3539IL

title: Highly recommend!
text: The best food and view in Barcelona! We booked a tour with my wife and our daugther and we loved it. Our guide, Thomas shared  a lot of interesting facts and his own funny stories from life in the city. Thank you for a wonderful time :)
author: Paradise33612386179
